_about: The character sheet: the keys every playful character is described by, and the labels each key may take. A character file (tools/art/<theme>/character.json) uses only these keys and labels; a new label goes here first. Types: label = one of values; labels = a list of values; number; text; timing = {frames, ms, loopFrom}, checked against the theme file; version = semver; map = an object whose keys and list values are both labels of the schema entry. Standards (ominous-theme skill) are marked in the description. A key with "standard": true is a standard of the ominous-theme skill.

version.description: The character's version (semver). Below 1.0.0: legacy art, drawn before the standards; its values describe what it is, not what it should be, and wait for a redraw. 1.0.0: the first redraw that meets the standards; minor: a change to an approved look (a palette tone); major: a redraw

status.description: legacy: below 1.0.0, not a model for other characters; redrawn: meets the standards

cue.description: What tells who it is at 40 cells

ref.source.description: The reference sheets behind the frames (drafts/<theme>/refs/), or none

palette.size.description: Colors in the palette, transparent not counted (checked against the theme file)

tense.face.description: The face when the meeting is close

tense.gaze.description: How the eyes move in tense

tense.closeup.description: The held close-up in tense's intro, between bust frames: bust, close-up, bust loop (standard: held)

tense.timing.description: Frames, interval and loop start of tense (checked against the theme file)

angry.intro.description: The transformation before the angry loop

angry.faces.description: The faces of the angry loop, in order: a short burst or a held face, then the long one

angry.sign.description: A manga sign drawn over the head (fixed reds, in front of the outline)

angry.light.description: How the scene lights the character

angry.shake.description: The jolt (standard): on the hand-over to the loop with an intro, else on entering

angry.timing.description: Frames, interval and loop start of angry (checked against the theme file)

angry.flashes.description: Worst flashes in one second on a light or dark card, at most 2 (checked by the flash test)

colors.roles.description: Theme roles used in the sprite (none: an empty list)

codixel.description: Where the codixel pixel-art skill did the work, part by part, and with what (rejected tries stay in drafts/<theme>/history/HISTORY.md). none: done by own code or by hand
